therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation inhibition via EGFR pathway blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with locally advanced or recurrent squamous cell skin cancer undergoing surgery and/or radiation therapy

results.effect_size: 31.8% early progression rate; overall response rate (CR+PR): 43.5% (10/23 patients)
biomarker_changes: EGFR and phospho-Akt expression analysis planned but sample size too small to determine EGFR-proliferative responses
results.dose_information: 250 mg/day orally for 60 days (2 cycles), dose escalation to 500 mg/day if no response at day 15

context.duration: induction therapy 60 days, followed by surgery/radiation, up to 5 years follow-up
